sloka: रामस्य उपरि संहृष्टा ववर्षुः विस्मिताः तदा ।अर्थ अधिक मुहूर्तेन रामेण निशितैः शरैः ॥३-३०-३०॥
transliteration: rāmasya upari saṁhṛṣṭā vavarṣuḥ vismitāḥ tadā ।artha adhika muhūrtena rāmeṇa niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥3-30-30॥

translations.english: For this purpose, killer of Paka, the gIorious Indra (who can break a fortress), came to the hermitage of Sarabhanga.
